text: Grogmar gro-Burzag is an Orsimer miner who resides at Odfel's House in the town of Shor's Stone. He works during the day in the Redbelly Mine. He is temporarily staying with Odfel, a fellow miner, because his own house has not been built yet.
Grok is a named giant who can be found roaming the far-western part of the tundra in the Whiterun Hold, just south of Rorikstead.

Grommok gro-Barak is an Orsimer warrior who is one of the three adventurers falling for the traps in the quest "Baiting the Trap" in Xedilian. He falls in the last choice of trap and is the one that wields Dawnfang/Duskfang.
Greyf was an Atmoran warrior. She was one of the Five Hundred Companions, and was married to Breff the Elder. Greyf and her husband were both a part of the Krilot Lok crew.
Gregor is a Nord Warrior who is appointed as the Dragonborn's housecarl upon becoming Thane of the Pale.

Grimkell was a wizard who embarked on a journey with three Nord warriors searching for Sovngarde; Erlendr, Hunroor, and Nikulas. Grimkell later betrayed them by turning them into stone pillars at Brodir Grove. The friend of the Nords, Ulfgar the Unending, killed Grimkell out of revenge.
Grubby Grunyun is an Orsimer found in a camp just outside Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. When the Vestige meets him, he will ask for help to get his friend Marq back.
Grenna gra-Kush is an Orsimer who resides in the city of Daggerfall. She can be found in The Rosy Lion inn. Grenna plays a very important role in the quest "Blood and the Crescent Moon."
Grulbash gro-Uzug is an Orsimer armorer residing in Aldcroft, Glenumbra. He has a stall, Warriors' Reserve, at the Lionguard Camp Market where he sells his wares.
Grizzlehide is a champion of the Crow's Wood public dungeon. Killing this creature counts towards the "Hero of Crow's Wood" and "Slayer of Crow's Wood" achievements.

Gritstone the Patriarch is a boss creature of the lost city of Na-Totambu public dungeon. Killing this creature counts towards the "Champions of the Lost City" and "Slayer of the Lost City" achievements.
Gregoire Lafont is a Breton innkeeper of the Rosy Lion Inn, located in Daggerfall , Glenumbra.
Gruluk gro-Khazun is an Orsimer residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. He stands by the docks, looking at arrivals to the island. Talking to him will start the quest "The Bloodthorn Plot."
Grobert Dantaine is a Breton residing in Daggerfall, Glenumbra. He works as a brewer in The Rosy Lion inn, where he sells his wares.
Gronov is an Orsimer merchant who resides in the city of Camlorn, in the region of Glenumbra. He appears after the quest "The Fall of Faolchu" is completed, and will sell his wares in a stall.
Gro-Ghash is an Orsimer residing in Steelheart Moorings, Stormhaven. He is one of the soldiers captured by the slavers and held in the Steelheart Cave outside the settlement.
Grildoriel is a Bosmer located in Khenarthi's Roost, in the port city of Mistral.
Green-Eyes-Wander is an Argonian who can be found in The Flaming Nix, an inn in Mournhold.
Grell Flan is a rabid character residing in the Flan House in Quarantine Serk.
Grugues is a Breton hall steward member of the Fighters Guild who resides in the Tal'Deic Fortress, Deshaan.
Greenvine Trader is a Bosmer residing in the city of Skywatch. They are a generalised Bosmer trader, and can be either male or female.

Groken is a Nord weaponsmith in who sells his wares at his stall, Groken's Great Weapons, at the trading hall in Bleakrock Village. He is only interactable before the "Escape from Bleakrock" is completed, since he does not survive the raid.
Grivette Henyra is a Breton laborer residing in the city of Wayrest.
Grodoguz the Blatherskite is an Orsimer residing in the city of Windhelm.
Grigerda is a Nord with an injured knee found inside the Manor House in Bruma. Author of Grigerda's Letter to Methas Andavel. Along with Hjorik is one of the two quest givers in Bruma.
Grubdosh is an Orsimer fisherman residing in the city of Northpoint, Rivenspire.
Grundag gra-Drol is an Orsimer armorer residing in the city of Hoarfrost Downs, Rivenspire. She can be found at her stall, Hammersong Plate and Mail, selling her wares.
Grunhere Wintermist is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Jorunn's Stand.
Grivier's Monstrosity is a bone colossus found on Balefire Island in Glenumbra.
Grothdarr is a Flesh Atronach boss that appears in the Vaults of Madness in Coldharbour.
Grobull the Transmuted is a powerful netch in . It is a boss creature found in Darkshade Caverns II, Deshaan, in .

Grievous Twilights are creatures that appear in . Located in the Imperial City, defeating these creatures earns the Vestige Tel Var Stones. They are a unique variation of winged twilights created by Molag Bal. As of Update 12 ("One Tamriel"), they can now have a chance to be located at any dark anchors.
Gruloq is an Orsimer found chopping wood by the siege camp outside Frostbreak Fortress in Wrothgar.
Grudogub is an Orsimer beggar found on the streets of the Morkul Stronghold, Wrothgar. He has no unique dialogue.
Gregorius Voteporix is an Imperial found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Green-Venom-Tongue is an Argonian assassin residing in Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
Gruber is a creature that appears in . It can be interacted with during Storming the Hall. Its previous master was killed by Rageclaw Clan Reachmen.
The Griefstricken Chef is a Nord contractor for the quest "The Dark Brotherhood Forever." He resides in the Windpeak Inn in Dawnstar.
Greycloak Archer is a generic archer in that is a member of the Greycloak Mercenaries.
Greycloak Bruiser is a generic Bruiser residing in locations .
Gristlehide Dreugh is a creature card in that is a part of The Fall of the Dark Brotherhood expansion.
Grumth is an Orsimer member of the Malacath Fanatics who have taken control of the Temple of Ire, in the city of Orsinium.
Greycloak Bruoser is a character in that is a member of the Greycloak Mercenaries.
Greycloak Mender is a character in that is a member of the Greycloak Mercenaries.
Greycloak Ravager is a character in that is a member of the Greycloak Mercenaries.
Greycloak Swordsman is a character in that is a member of the Greycloak Mercenaries.
Gromazgu is an Orsimer residing in Sadrith Mora, Vvardenfell. He is a member of Bothamul's group, Ropefish.
Grenbet is an Orsimer commoner residing with her clan beneath Exile's Barrow. She has no unique dialogue.
Grethaa is a Nord information broker found in the Outlaws Refuge of Davon's Watch, Vulkhel Guard or Daggerfall, depending on the Vestige's Alliance.
Groddi is an Orsimer residing in Hallin's Stand, Bangkorai, in . She is sweeping the central square of the town.
Gremlins, also known as Orc-Rats, are small, harmless creatures related to goblins, whom they can be found living alongside.
Grog is an Orsimer who is first found in Eldbur Ruins. His companions, Cainar and Miriya, are trapped within K'Tora's mind trap, though he is able to resist it.

Grularz is a deceased Orsimer in found at Crestshade Mine in Rivenspire, High Rock. Grularz was researching trolls and managed to gain the trust of the patriarch of the Crestshade Mine trolls, Grimtooth. Her research notes end before she attempted to hug Grimsooth.
Guril Retheran is a Dunmer assassin and member of House Redoran who resides in the Vivec, Redoran Canton. He also carries the Glove of Sanguine Horny Fist.
Gudling the Rascal is a Nord Hunter at the St. Veloth's Hostel in Molag Mar. He does not provide any services and is not involved in any quests.
Guilbert Jemane is a Breton living at the Newlands Lodge in Cheydinhal. Guilbert has a twin brother named Reynald.
Gunder is a Nord and the proprietor of the Colovian Traders in Skingrad.
Gureryne Selvilo is a Dunmer healer who lives in Chorrol. He can usually be found near The Oak and Crosier, Northern Goods and Trade or in the Chapel of Stendarr.

Gukimir is a Nord warrior from Skyrim who appears at the Priory of the Nine seeking to join the Knights of the Nine with his brother Geimund. Both he and his brother gained their skills in combat while serving in the Imperial Legion. When they heard about the attacks on the chapels and that the Knights of the Nine were reforming, they traveled to the Priory in hopes of joining the fight against Umaril. When accepted into the Knights, they will re-equip themselves with the standard armor all of the knights wear: a Knights of the Nine Shield and Cuirass with a chainmail helmet, gauntlets, greaves, and boots.
Gundalas is a Bosmer trader who lives in Leyawiin. He owns the Best Goods and Guarantees, where he sells general items with Elsynia.
Gwinas is a Bosmer from Valenwood who is interested in Mankar Camoran's Commentaries of the Mythic Dawn.

Haakon is a Nord Barbarian, and miner residing in Morrowind. He can be found in the company of the witch Thelsa Dral in the Asha-Ahhe Egg Mine south of Khuul in the West Gash region of Vvardenfell. As an associate of Thelsa Dral, he is hostile to the Nerevarine and will attack on sight.
Gunjar was a soldier of the Stormcloaks who was captured along with the Dragonborn and Ralof at Helgen.

Gulum-Ei is an Argonian dockworker who works in the East Empire Company Warehouse, and helps to process all of the shipments of goods that go in and out of Solitude. He can be found in The Winking Skeever during the day to fence stolen goods. He is the brother of Deeja and Jaree-Ra.
Gwendolyn is a Nord farmhand who works for the Battle-Born clan.

Guardian Saerek is a Draugr who can be found inside Ragnvald Crypts. He must be killed in order to obtain one of the keys to unlock the sarcophagus of Dragon Priest Otar the Mad. He can be summoned by picking up his skull from the pedestral in the middle of the room.
Gularzob is an Orsimer who lives in the Orc stronghold of Largashbur.
Gunding is a Nord miner working at the Whistling Mine. He can often be found sleeping near the entrance or mining the iron ore veins.
Gul is an Orsimer miner who works in the Mor Khazgur Mine in the Orc stronghold of Mor Khazgur in Haafingar hold.
The Guildmaster is the head of the Thieves Guild. The title for the Cyrodiilic Thieves Guild was the Gray Fox.
Gul gro-Burbog is an Orsimer savant and a devout worshiper of Clavicus Vile. He can be found at the Shrine of Clavicus Vile alongside his fellow worshipers.
Guldrise Dralor is a Dunmer member of the Thieves Guild residing on the Dren Plantation.
Gulena Girith is a Dunmer Healer who works in the Asha-Ahhe Egg Mine. She can be found in the company of the witch Thelsa Dral in the lower parts of the egg mine.
Guls Llervu is a Dunmer priest and lawman who can be found in his home in Ald'ruhn.

Gulvilie Arinith is a Dunmer warrior who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton. She can be found in the St. Olms Underworks, where she seems to guard the entrance to the Daedric shrine named Assernerairan. She is hostile and attacks the Nerevarine on sight.
Gulitte Cienne is a Breton mage residing in the Daedric ruin of Ihinipalit.
Gunmar is a Nord hunter in who is a master trainer in Smithing. He is an old friend of Isran, who mentions that he hates vampires almost as much as Isran himself does.
Gurak gro-Bagrat is an Orsimer skooma smuggler who resides on the Gro-Bagrat Plantation.
Gugnir is a Nord found injured southeast of the Dogeater Goblin Camp. Him, his brothers and five other guards went there to try to cull the goblins but all except for him were killed.
Gurilda is a Nord scholar found inside Headman Bhosek's palace in Port Hunding.
Guarg gro-Yarzol is an Orsimer Commoner and member of House Hlaalu, who resides in the Vivec, Hlaalu Canton. Guarg is not related to any quests, nor does he have any special dialogue.
Guyseph Cergend is a Breton merchant who resides in the city of Daggerfall. He can be found in the market, selling medium-armors.
Gwen is a Redguard bandit warrior, and resides in the cave of Nund.
Guild Savant is a mage that resides in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.
Gwaering is a Bosmer located in Silvenar. Gwaering is the successor of her aunt Finoriell as The Green Lady. She marries the new Silvenar, Indaenir.
Gwaerinbor is a Bosmer drunkard residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Guy LeBlanc is a Breton who is found near Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. He is standing by a cart with the goods on the ground, apparently having just been attacked.
Gulorz is an Orsimer who is found in the Wyrd camp near Tangle Rock in Glenumbra. She is a refugee from Camlorn.
Guard Adele is a Breton, residing in the Lion Guard camp near Dwynnarth Ruins, Glenumbra.
Guard Edelinne is a Breton residing in Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. She is found guarding the warehouse where Messenger Cordier is held.
Gualtierus Spurius is an Imperial smuggler residing in the Gandrung Caverns.
Gudyn is a Breton residing in Alcaire Castle, Stormhaven. He's found outside Alcaire Keep, near the large pond sitting on a rock.
Guy Molose is a Breton mystic and member of the Mages Guild residing in Wayrest in Stormhaven. He can be found in the local guildhall where he sells his wares.
Guilenarth is a Bosmer woman who can be found wandering Sarandel's Carnival, in the region of Grahtwood.
Gwilandor is a Bosmer who can be found in Bramblebreach, in the Greenshade region of Valenwood.
Guroanii Orethi is a Dunmer brewer. She works at The Flaming Nix in Mournhold.
Gulmon Droth is a Dunmer cultist residing in the city of Kragenmoor. He is found at the slave pens, parousing the slaves kept there.
Gwilgoth Branchbreaker is a Bosmer residing in the city of Silvenar.
Gudomar Ironfist is a Nord mage initially found at the Mournhold docks. He is later found inside the dormitory in Shad Astula.
Gwinor is a Bosmer laborer residing in the city of Skywatch.
Gulugash gra-Orguk is an Orsimer found at the Silver Moons Inn in the Baandari Trading Post.
Grushnag is an Orsimer residing in the castle in the city of Evermore, Bangkorai.
Gunagud is an Orsimer residing in the city of Sentinel, Alik'r.
Gruudus gro-Dush is an Orsimer residing in the city of Sentinel, Alik'r.
Guendeline Ascenge is a Breton residing in the town of Hoarfrost Downs. She is the love interest of Julien Rissiel.
Gyrard Leraud is a Breton residing in the town of Wind Keep.
Gudaric the Silent is a Nord patron of the Cold Moon Inn in Windhelm.
Gungrim is a Nord residing in the Abbey of the Eight in Cyrodiil.
Grushbub is an Orsimer chef who resides in the city of Vulkwasten, Malabal Tor. He sells various food items at his stall, Grushbub's Grub.
Gruznak the Impatient is a powerful Orsimer warrior of the Oathbound Clan found in Malak's Maw. He is the author of About Mercy.
Guard Belic is a Breton soldier of House Montclair found just outside Northpoint.
Guard Lynie is a Breton soldier of House Montclair found just outside Northpoint.
Guard-Captain Faryon is a Dunmer ghost found at the Iliath Temple in Stonefalls.
Guard-Captain Nerathren is a Dunmer ghost found at the Iliath Temple in Stonefalls.
Guardian Celonron is a Bosmer ghost found in the ruins of Ouze. He serves as its ever-lasting guardian.
Guardian Sud-Hareem is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild trapped inside Spindleclutch I, Glenumbra, in . He is the father of At'avar.
Guide Culast is an Altmer noble and city guide in who resides in the city of Skywatch on Auridon. She will give information about Skywatch when asked.
Guillaume Loganne is a Breton member of the Mages Guild found at their camp in the Glenumbra Moors.
Gula is an Orsimer found on the Sentinel Docks in the Alik'r Desert.

Gulakhan Harrinat is a Dunmer Ashlander member of the Mabrigash Tribe. He is found in their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake. As the Gulakhan of the tribe, he act as the military leader among the tribesmen but has no real say on the political matters.
Guldir is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their guildhall in Riften.
Gulfa Red-Beard is a Nord traveling merchant. She sells her wares on the road north of Thulvald's Logging Camp in Eastmarch.
Gulzog the Butcher is an Orsimer member of the Iron Orcs clan found in the Valley of Scars. He is the author of The Care and Feeding of Trolls.
Guth is an Orsimer member of the Fighters Guild residing at their enclave at Shinji's Scarp, Stormhaven.
Guuth gra-Shelakh is an Orsimer found at the Thizzrini Arena.
Guz is an Orsimer found with her companion Eldinaran at their camp in Rivenspire at one of their possible locations. The Vestige can light their fire as part of the Lightbringer achievement.
Guzash gra-Bar is an Orsimer Soul Shriven found in The Black Forge.
Gudarz is a Redguard bandit ringleader who infiltrated the militia at the Saltwalker Militia Camp.
Gwendis is a Bosmer vampire and a member of House Ravenwatch who can be found in Ravenwatch Castle. She is a close friend and the protege of Count Verandis Ravenwatch.
Gwenieth is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild found in the hall of the Elden Root.
Gwindebros is a Bosmer stylemaster and member of the Aldmeri Dominion found in the irrigation tunnels within the sewers beneath the Imperial City. He is the owner of Tradesman's Retreat.
Guzmara is an Orsimer noble found sitting and writing in the northern edge of Morkuldin Haven's wall.
Habais is a Khajiit merchant. He sells his wares in Morkuldin Haven.
Guruzug is an Orsimer daily job broker found at the Clan Longhouse in the stronghold of Morkul, Wrothgar. He is a member of the Dragonstar Caravan Company.
Gunneke is a Nord found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.
Gwaegalir was a Bosmer residing at the Cat's Eye Quay prior to the Maormer invasion. His corpse is found there after they are driven away.
Gwynienne is a Breton residing inside Charlebert Dalielle's home in Wayrest.
Gukirmar is a Nord part of the Saltwalker Militia. She is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Gushorg is a male Orsimer sailor drinking at a table in The Saucy Nix in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell. He has no unique dialogue.
Gunnar is an unseen character in . He was the husband of Lisbet, and according to her, was killed in a Forsworn attack. During the quest "The Taste of Death," Lisbet reveals that she ate Gunnar.
Captain Gulan was Prince Attrebus' right hand man. He was part of his personal bodyguard.
Gwingelruin is a Bosmer residing in Mother's Den, a sublocation of the Shimmerene Waterworks underneath the city of Shimmerene, Summerset. He has no unique dialogue.
Gursthuk is an Orsimer beggar located beneath the garrison of Torug's Arch near Orsinium. Apparently, Gursthuk used to be a hunts-wife of an Orcish chief.
Guthrum of the Isles is a Nord who appears in the Town in . He serves as the local priest of the Nine Divines.
Gulum-La is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe residing in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Grynkx, The Edge Who Hungers is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses melee attacks.
Guleesh is an Argonian residing in western Lilmoth, engaging in flirtatious conversation with Wawul.
The Guardian of the Earth is an Ehlnofey spirit residing in the Vale of the Guardians, Glenumbra, in .
The Guardian of the Water is an Ehlnofey spirit residing in the Vale of the Guardians, Glenumbra, in .
Gyl is a non-hostile Scamp in that resides in Fargrave City District.
Guiffa Larocque is a Breton residing in Gonfalon Bay. She is a member of the Roister's Club.
Guild Scholar Valessea is an Altmer residing in the Ascendant Order Hideout in Vvardenfell.
Guild Herald Amsaad is a Khajiit located in Belkarth, Craglorn, in .
Guardian of the True Path is a Redguard located in Rahni'Za, School of Warriors, Craglorn, in .
Gurilda Sharktooth was an Atmoran warrior and a member of the Five Hundred Companions. She was the Captain of the crew of the Fallowfire.

Hannibal Traven is a Breton and the Arch-Mage of the Mages Guild in Cyrodiil. He is also the author of The Black Arts On Trial. He has an enmity towards Necromancy, and was responsible for its banning from the Mages Guild.

Hafid Hollowleg is a Nord publican and proprietor of the Jerall View Inn in Bruma. He sells food and rents his rooms for 25. Hafid serves his tavern most of the time, only stopping to eat at 8pm for two hours. Hafid is one of the townspeople that cheers on Martin when he marches off to the Battle of Bruma.
Hallgerd is a fictional storyteller. He appears in several books, including: *Hallgerd's Tale *Bone, Book I *Bone, Book II *Vernaccus and Bourlor
Hairan is a Dunmer Hunter, and a well-respected warrior and brother of the clan of Ashlanders at Erabenimsun Camp, in which he resides.

Han-Ammu is a Dunmer Herder residing in Erabenimsun Camp. He can usually be found in his yurt. Han-Ammu is an Ashlander and Gulakhan of the Erabenimsun tribe. Despite his position within the tribe, he dislikes fighting. During the quest "Erabenimsun Nerevarine," Han-Ammu becomes Ashkhan of the Erabenimsun, and then names the Nerevarine as their war-leader. Due to his important role in the Main Quest, he is an essential character. It is known that Han-Ammu's father was Airan-Ammu, an Ashkhan who wielded the War Axe of Airan Ammu.

Hakar the Candle is a Nord Smith in Molag Mar, Morrowind. Although he resides at the Redoran Stronghold atop the city, he is not a member of the House. Hakar offers wares for sale in addition to his repair services. He is not involved in any quests.
Hairan Mannanalit is a Dunmer Scout residing in Vos, in the Grazelands. She is found in the Varo Tradehouse.
Hainab Lasamsi is a Dunmer living in Gnisis in the West Gash. He is responsible for the theft of the pants of Hentus Yansurnummu, and is regarded as a bit of a prankster.
Hannabi Zabynatus is a Dunmer living in Gnisis in the West Gash. She is the local smith and sells a variety of goods.

Hal-Liurz is an Argonian who is the stewardess for Skingrad. She speaks to visitors on behalf of Janus Hassildor, who prefers to keep face to face interactions to a minimal. If the Hero of Kvatch needs to speak to the Count, they will need to speak to Hal-Liurz. If she feels it is important, she will go speak with the count. Otherwise she will either handle it herself or recommend asking Shum gro-Yarug or Mercator, two others the Count trust to handle things. Hal-Liurz can be found in the castle's main hall during the day, only leaving at night to eat dinner and head to bed for four hours of sleep before returning to work.

Hans Black-Nail is the blacksmith at Castle Bravil. He is also a sleeper agent of the Mythic Dawn. Hans mentions that he knew Count Regulus Terentius when they were both younger and Regulus was a "shining star on the tournament path."

Hagaer is a Bosmer commoner who lives in his house in the Imperial City Temple District. The Hero, can spot him wandering around his home district, wearing a Green Brocade Doublet and matching Green Silk Garment and shoes. Hagear is an avid reader, and a collector of books. When spoken to he will admit to having a hard time walking by the book store without going inside. On an average day, he will leave his home at 7am to eat breakfast at The All-Saints Inn, and stay for three hours before heading to the Arcane University. He will stay at the university and talk until he leaves to the Arboretum where he will stay before he heads home at six. On Loredas, he will stay home until eight, then he
Haening is a Nord living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the local Fighters Guild. He can be found inside The East Empire North Warehouse with the Altmer Fiiriel.
Hadvar is a Nord soldier from Riverwood in who serves in the Imperial Legion. He is also the nephew of Alvor, the blacksmith from Riverwood
Haesmar is a Nord Barbarian who resides in Ramimilk, Morrowind.
Haki is a Nord barbarian who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.
Haelga is a Nord who lives in Riften, where she runs Haelga's Bunkhouse with her niece, Svana.
Hajvarr Iron-Hand is a Nord warrior, and is the chief of a gang of bandits operating out of the cave of White River Watch.
Hamal, also known as Mother Hamal, is the Nord High Priestess of the Temple of Dibella in the city of Markarth.

Hakon One-Eye was a Nord hero who helped overthrow the dragons in ancient times. He can be observed at the Throat of the World during the quest Alduin's Bane, and later found in the Hall of Valor in Sovngarde, during the quest "Sovngarde."

Hafjorg is an Elder Nord alchemy merchant in Riften. She is married to Elgrim and helps run his shop, Elgrim's Elixirs. According to her, she knows how to concoct basic potions, but is no master alchemist. She is generally kind towards the Dragonborn and her husband, though she disapproves of the location of the shop along the Riften canal waterways. She is typically found behind the counter though she can offer services when elsewhere in the shop as well. She and Elgrim share the same inventory and gold amount, so there is little difference from bartering with either one unless the Dragonborn prefers Hafjorg's more polite demeanor.
Haldyn is a Redguard battlemage found in Japhet's Folly Towers on the island called Japhet's Folly. He is the primary antagonist of the quest "Rise in the East."
Haming is a Nord child and one of the few survivors of Alduin's attack on Helgen, where he once lived.

Halion is an Altmer bard who resides the settlement of Hale in the Shivering Isles. Halion is a poet by trade, even going so far as only speaking in rhyme. Halion carries his key, a quill and a cheese wheel. He may carry scrolls and a small amount of gold. When spoken to, Halion have information and rumors on most every event, item, location, and person of note in the Shivering Isles.
Hana was a brown-skinned, black-haired maid who had been traveling with young Barenziah for some time.
Haleneri Salor is a Dunmer Thief who lives in Odirniran. She is a member of House Hlaalu, and can be found in Odirniran.
Hainab is a Dunmer Herder residing in the Urshilaku Camp. She is a member of the Urshilaku Tribe of Ashlanders.

Hannat Zainsubani is a Dunmer who was last heard of charting Mamaea. He is the son of Hassour Zainsubani in Ald'ruhn and continues the family business as a merchant, focusing on the trade with ebony. He is also a member of the Thieves Guild.

Hansi Saharnatturapli is a Dunmer Mabrigash residing within the Ashlands of Morrowind. She resides at a bonfire camp on a little hill northeast and next to Berandas. She, along with her partners, Hinummu Siddurnanit and Elitlaya Assonirishpal will attack the Nerevarine on sight, unless a charm spell is cast, followed by raising their dispositions.
Hagrad the Stone is a Nord barbarian living in Skaal Village.
Hadhuul, colloquially referred to as the Fire King, was the Ayleid King of the city of Ceyatatar in Cyrodiil. His ghost can be encountered by the Vestige.
Hand Drals Indobar is a Dunmer Warrior who serves as a Hand of Almalexia. He is located in the high chapel of Mournhold Temple.
Hand Vonos Veri is a Dunmer warrior who serves as a Hand of Almalexia. He is located in the high chapel of Mournhold Temple.
Hand Sadas Mavandes is a Dunmer warrior who serves as a Hand of Almalexia. He is located in the high chapel of Mournhold Temple.
Hand Savor Hlan is a Dunmer warrior who serves as a Hand of Almalexia. He is located in the high chapel of Mournhold Temple.
Hanana is a Nord residing in the city of Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She is typically found sitting next to a building near the Mudcrab fights.
Halmaera is a Nord found at her house just outside Bleakrock Village. She is seeking help in finding her lost husband and dog, Geilund and Rexus.
Haerdon is an Redguard residing in Saintsport, Stros M'Kai. He is one of Crafty Lerisa's crew and has been captured by the Sea Drakes.
Halinirya is an Altmer commoner residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade.
Hanriian is a Bosmer tailor residing in Woodhearth in the region of Greenshade. She owns Hanriian's Handsome Tailoring inside Traders Tree.
Hamus is a Khajiit residing in Redfur Trading Post in the region of Grahtwood.
Handyn is a Breton residing at the Old Goat Inn in Alcaire Castle.
Hafizah is a Redguard residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He is found in the Fighters Guild working as an armsman.
Hakra is a Nord and a deceased member of the original Five Hundred Companions. She appears as a spirit in Pinepeak Cavern, where her soul is being held captive and sapped by the Worm Cult.
Haina-Daro is a Khajiit chef. She sells her wares at the Temple of the Crescent Moons.
Hand Arnas Therethi is a Dunmer Warrior who serves as a Hand of Almalexia. He is located in the high chapel of Mournhold Temple.
Haldoril is an Altmer who can be seen following Inspector Tarma, taking studious notes. He can be found at the Laughing Moons Plantation during and after the quest "A Pinch of Sugar."
Haheiba is a Khajiit residing in Mistral, the port city of Khenarthi's Roost.
Hanthaerin is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild expedition found in Ezduiin, an ancient Ayleid Ruin. She cannot be interacted with directly.
Hali the Impatient is a Nord residing in the city of Mournhold.
Hagaelion is a Bosmer residing in the Shrouded Vale, in the region of Greenshade.
Halseth is a Dunmer patron of The Hissing Guar in Kragenmoor.
Hadmar the Thin-Boned is a Nord mage first found at the Mournhold docks. He is later encountered in Shad Astula after his admission into the academy.
Halinan is an Altmer who resides in the town of Silsailen, on the island of Auridon.
Halyen Thunder-Fury is a Nord residing in the town of Narsis.
Halim Herethi is a character residing in the city of Mournhold.
Halar Cadiou is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild. He is the armsman of their branch in Shornhelm.
Haidar al-Sentinel is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel.
Hafayidra is a Redguard residing in the town of Hoarfrost Downs.
Hannura is a Nord residing in Chorrol. She rakes a small part of land near the Oak and Crosier. She has a friend by the name of Mansa.
Hadima is a Redguard laborer working at Nimare's Noble Steeds in Marbruk.
Hadran is a Bosmer slave trader found at his caravan along with his gang.
Hadras is a Bosmer participating in the frog races in Skywatch. He is found with his frog, Hopper.
Hahnin is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild part of the final assault against Molag Bal.
Haj-Tei is an Argonian residing in the outlaws refuge beneath Stormhold. She can be found training her pet pony guar named Sithis.
Haj-Tulm is an Argonian Shadowscale trying to retake Murkwater from the Dominion.
Haki Sunfeather is a Nord mage first found at the Mournhold docks and later in Shad Astula after her admission into the academy.
Halalin is a deceased Bosmer member of the Falinesti Faithful found at the Falinesti Spring Site. He was tortured to death by Drublog.
Halaral is a Khajiit of the Baandari found begging at their trading post in Malabal Tor.
Hald Bitterblade is a Nord commander of the Stormfist Clan found at his camp near Jorunn's Stand.
Haldesan is a Redguard part of the group of outlaws found beneath Shornhelm.
Halindor is a Bosmer found in Greenhill. He is drunk upon first encountering him, and can be prompted to start the quest "On the Doorstep."
Halinuk is a Khajiit patron of the Five Claws Inn in Woodhearth.
Halitazi-dra is a Khajiit farmer found at the Windcatcher Plantation.
Hallfrida is the Nord granddaughter of Thane Unnvald Ironhand, found in Fullhelm Fort.
Haltafi is a Nord moneylender and part of the group of outlaws found inside the refuge in Vulkhel Guard, Auridon.
Hama the Stalwart is a Nord miner working at the Lost Knife Cave.
Hamira is a Khajiit enchanter and a member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Velyn Harbor, where she also operates her stall, The Mysterious Glyph.
Hani is a Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. She is found in Eagle's Strand.
Hanmaer Furmender is a Nord who resides in the town of Lower Yorgrim, Eastmarch.
Hannat the Bonebringer is a Redguard member of the Worm Cult found in the ruins of Rulanyil's Fall.

Hantaari is an Altmer found in Marbruk in the region of Greenshade, Valenwood. She is a novelist who travelled to Marbruk for inspiration, but who is now disgusted by the Bosmer culture and the wild nature surrounding the city. She is found sitting and writing on a flight of stairs while regretting her coming to the city.
Hald Windtorn is a Nord soldier of the Pact held captive in The Lion's Den.
Hansee is a cat residing at The Boatman's Tail in the port city of Mistral, Khenarthi's Roost.
Halridor is a Bosmer member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is part of the team found outside Ne Salas.
Hal-Nei is an Argonian member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Fort Virak, Stonefalls.
Hadkyr is a Nord found at the Sailor's Rest in Abah's Landing.
Haidarah is a Redguard found in the Apprentice Lodgings in the Bazaar District of Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane. She is impossible to interact with.
Haenelisse is a deceased Altmer researcher whose body is found in Coldperch Cavern. She is the author of Birds of Wrothgar.
Haj Mota is a large turtlelike creature found in various locations, particularly desert areas, beaches, and swamps.
Hamelyn Serpe is a Breton residing in Morkuldin Haven, Wrothgar.
Hamsaman is a Khajiit residing in Balmora, in Vvardenfell. He cannot be interacted with.

Hakkvild Yashnag-Slayer was the Jarl of Falkreath during the Interregnum and before the Alliance War that started in 2E 582. Hakkvild was the son of the previous Jarl, who was killed by Yashnag gro-Yazgu, the Orcish Chieftain of his own Orcish Kingdom of Falkreath. Yashnag ruled Western Falkreath with his band of Orcs and terrorized the rest of Falkreath. Hakkvild challenged Yashnag to a duel, resulting in Yashnag's death and the end of the chiefdom. The Orcs scattered into Wrothgar and eventually created the second iteration of Orsinium. Hakkvild would rule the city of Falkreath until he passed away and his child assumed the throne.

The Hadran's Marksman is an enemy that appears in Reaper's March, in . They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be worn to avoid them. These enemies are found in Hadran's Caravan after the Vestige has started the chase after Hadran.
Hahdemir is a Redguard member of the Clockwork Apostles found at the Clockwork Basilica in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
